_doc: Firmament Ages - The Primordial's ring shots (round G4, Felix 2026-10-18, SPEC 39.2): one row per Age segment of the halo.
firmages-core boss/BossShots reads it (the build copies it into the jar, this datapack copy wins). The ring fires one segment
after the other, Age 0 first; 'interval_ticks' per phase is the time between two shots, 'speed' blocks per tick,
'damage' before the player's armour, 'radius' the burst around the impact, 'knockback' the push off the impact, 'count' shots
per release in a fan of 'spread_deg', 'pierce' living targets one shot passes through, 'trail' the particles per tick.
Effects: fire_seconds (Bronze), levitation_seconds and blindness_seconds (Arcane), cloud_seconds with cloud_radius, slowness
and poison (Industrial), chain_hops / chain_range / chain_damage (Electric), hunger_seconds and wither_seconds (Information),
well_ticks / well_radius / pull / push (Space: the gravity well, then the shove), freeze_seconds and slowness_seconds (Quantum),
well_* plus implosion_damage / implosion_radius (Singularity), phase_from and every_cycles (Singularity: phase 3 only, one
cycle in three). The fight model (boss/FightModel) sums the rows for the damage a player takes who does not dodge.
